listed_sector_signals.quote:
Stoica, A., Sandberg, M. & Holby, O. Energy use and
recovery strategies within wastewater treatment and sludge
handling at pulp and paper mills. Bioresource Technology
100, 3497–3505.

one_line: The paper develops and validates energy performance indicators via a field study of 17 Portuguese municipal wastewater treatment plants, a water/wastewater service utility context, not continuous-flow Corpus-B industrial production.
